title: refactor(Development/AutomorphicArithmetic/AutomorphicVarieties/ModularityArgument/ThresholdArguments/DenseThresholdCases): reuse PfHRep helpers in THolRep
body:
Reuse the already-public `UpperTheory.Esk.HeckeRepresentationSatake` lemmas from `PositivityTheory/AutomorphicForms/PublishedInputs/JacquetLanglands/TorusKernels/PfHRep.lean` (and `UpperTheory.Esk.isHolV_of`) inside `THolRep.lean`, removing 19 duplicated private declarations.

Removed private declarations in `THolRep.lean`:
- `stable_iSup`, `proj`, `rt_lie`, `lie_eq_sum`, `rt_Eop`, `cap_act`, `cap_all`
- `hecke_eq_dc`, `iwahori_level_zero_eq`, `hecke_Tj`, `sat_two`, `uop_map`, `fin_scalar`, `unit_det`
- `expo_abs`, `sign_abs`
- `rot`, `rot_add`, `sign_hol`
